headline: Precious Metal Prices Remain Stuck in the Low Range
summary: Precious metal prices fell together in the final session of the week as the US dollar and US Treasury yields rose. Prices remain in a low range and are unlikely to rise much year on year.
why: Precious metals often trade inversely to the US dollar and real interest rates, since a stronger dollar and higher yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.
